## Goal

- describe one issue-sized outcome

## Primary Agent

- `product-agent` | `backend-agent` | `ios-agent` | `integration-agent` | `review-agent`

## Secondary Agents

- `none`

## Inputs

- specific doc, file, contract, PR, or artifact

## Constraints

- boundary to preserve, or `none`

## Done When

- observable completion check
- observable completion check

## Out of Scope

- explicit non-goal

## Test Notes

- validation approach, or `none`

## Follow-up Issues

- issue identifier, or `none`
